correctness.rationale: For any regular d-simplex d>=3, N=d+1, λ in (0,1), squared distances to vertex i depend on -2x_i, so farthest means least barycentric weight. Sorted update sort(λz_1+1−λ,λz_2,...,λz_N) is a strict λ-contraction in sup norm since order statistics are nonexpansive, with unique distinct fixed values s_i=(1−λ)λ^(N−i)/(1−λ^N). Its positive uniform minimum adjacent gap δ gives finite global lock-in: after T the minimum is uniquely boosted to maximum at each step and other relative ranks stay unchanged. Any sorted periodic state must equal s; all N! permutations yield exactly (N−1)!=d! primitive N-cycles, return derivative λ^N I. From lock-in each trajectory follows the exact same cyclic branch sequence as one periodic point, yielding phase-aligned λ^k convergence; label permutation symmetry off countably many tie hyperplanes gives basin fraction 1/d!. Independent rational checks enumerated every candidate permutation and its exact return and unique itinerary for N=4,5 and λ=1/3,1/2,3/4 (6 and 24 cycles). These checks do not prove the all-real-parameter statement.
